summary: Devon Energy Corp filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Coterra Energy Inc. via merger. Each Coterra share was converted into 0.70 Devon shares (stock consideration). The transaction closed on May 7, 2026, following stockholder approval at special meetings on May 4, 2026. No per-share price or premium was stated. Coterra equity awards were converted into Devon awards. The merger was registered on Form S-4 (File No. 333-294222), effective March 26, 2026. Watch for integration progress and any post-merger operational updates; risk-arb spread has collapsed as the deal is closed.
